title: Basic Safety for Water and Wastewater Operators
statusDescription: Educational foundation course. Not submitted for regulatory approval in any jurisdiction.
audience: Operators and trainees across the US and Canada preparing for certification exams and renewal in water and wastewater work.
outcomes: Find hazards before work and rank controls using the hierarchy of controls.
Recognise what makes a space confined and why its air can change.
Explain why trenches collapse and what sloping, shoring and shielding are for.
Recognise common treatment chemicals, their hazards and why incompatible products are stored apart.

modules.title: Hazard recognition and personal protective equipment
modules.summary: Find hazards before work and rank controls using the hierarchy of controls. Match PPE to the hazard it protects against and read labels and safety data sheets. Recognise respirator program, falling-object, abrasive blasting, solvent and biological hazards and their basic controls.

modules.title: Confined spaces and atmospheric hazards
modules.summary: Recognise what makes a space confined and why its air can change. Explain the purpose of testing, ventilation, an attendant, a rescue plan and a permit, and why smell is not a warning. Recognise what IDLH and SCBA mean and why explosion-proof equipment is required in classified flammable-gas areas.

modules.title: Excavations, traffic, energy and lifting
modules.summary: Explain why trenches collapse and what sloping, shoring and shielding are for. Recognise the purpose of traffic control, lockout and tagout, and safe lifting, tool and noise controls. Recognise the purpose of grounding, GFCI protection, hot work permits, arc screens and crane and hoist safeguards.

modules.title: Chemical safety and emergency awareness
modules.summary: Recognise common treatment chemicals, their hazards and why incompatible products are stored apart. Describe awareness-level responses to leaks, spills, fire and emergencies, and the roles of drills, near-miss reports and security. Recognise hydrogen peroxide, cross-connection and non-potable marking, battery, food and laboratory contamination and fire-class hazards.
